concepts.title: Properties and real-life problems

lessons.title: Dividing integers
text: Division follows the same sign rules: (−48) ÷ (−6) = 8 and (−48) ÷ 6 = −8.
0 ÷ (non-zero) = 0. Division by 0 is not defined.

lessons.title: Properties and real-life problems
text: Multiplication of integers is commutative and associative, and it distributes over addition: a × (b + c) = a × b + a × c.
Use integers for scores with penalties, temperatures, heights above and below sea level, and lifts.

mistakes: Thinking (−)(−) is negative.
Treating 8 − (−7) as 1.
Saying a number ÷ 0 = 0.
Counting negative signs wrongly in long products.
checklist: Write the sign rule you use.
Check the sign at the end.
